description: This file contains React components and functions related to link management in the Notesnook editor, including adding, editing, removing, and opening links, as well as internal link handling.

classes.name: LinkDefinition
classes.description: Type defining the structure of a link with href and optional title.

classes.name: LinkToolProps
classes.description: Type extending ToolProps with additional properties for link editing.

methods.name: LinkSettings
methods.description: Component rendering link settings options in the toolbar.

methods.name: AddLink
methods.description: Component for adding or editing a link in the editor.

methods.name: AddInternalLink
methods.description: Component for inserting an internal link.

methods.name: EditLink
methods.description: Component for editing an existing link, including internal links.

methods.name: RemoveLink
methods.description: Component for removing a link from selected text.

methods.name: OpenLink
methods.description: Component for opening the link URL in a new tab or external handler.

methods.name: CopyLink
methods.description: Component for copying the link URL to clipboard.

methods.name: LinkTool
methods.description: Helper component rendering link insertion/edit popup.

methods.name: isInternalLink
methods.description: Function to determine if a URL is an internal link based on prefix 'nn://'.
